# The Divi Woo Related Products Module

!!! abstract "Quick Reference"
    **What it is:** Shows automatically generated related products, based on WooCommerce's logic of shared categories or tags.
    **Where it lives:** Gray Plus icon in a Row, then the WooCommerce folder (or use search).
    **Requires:** WooCommerce installed and activated.

Place it in product templates or other layouts and control the number of products, columns, and styling to keep shoppers browsing.

## Add the module

1. Click the **Green Plus** icon to add a Row.
2. Click the **Gray Plus** icon inside the Row to open the module list.
3. Open the **WooCommerce** folder and select **Woo Related Products**, or search for it.

See [Divi WooCommerce Modules](divi-woocommerce-modules.md) for the full set of Woo modules.

## Use cases

- **Custom product templates:** add it below the product details to encourage further exploration.
- **Cross-sell opportunities:** show related items in sidebars or promotional sections.
- **Landing pages:** let shoppers discover more products without returning to the shop.

## Settings

### Content tab

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| Content | Choose the product and set: **Product Count**, **Column Layout**, **Order**, **Included Categories** (which WooCommerce categories related products come from), and **Product Offset Number**. |
| [Elements](../options-groups/elements.md) | Toggle **Show Name**, **Show Image**, **Show Price**, **Show Rating**, and **Show Sale Badge**. |
| [Link](../options-groups/link.md) | Makes the whole Woo Related Products module clickable, pointing to a page, section, or external URL. |
| [Background](../options-groups/background.md) | Background styles for the module. |
| Order | Position of the module within a Flexbox or Grid layout (see [Flexbox layout](../builder/understanding-divi-s-new-flexbox-layout.md)). |
| [Meta](../options-groups/meta.md) | Label text for the module and a switch to force its visibility inside the Visual Builder. |

### Design tab

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| [Overlay](../options-groups/overlay.md) | Styles for the featured image overlay, including its background color and icon. |
| [Image](../options-groups/image.md) | Featured image styles such as border, box shadow, and spacing. |
| Star Rating | Styles for product rating stars. |
| Sale Badge | Styles for the sale badge. |
| [Text](../options-groups/text.md) | Styles for the review count text. |
| [Title Text](../options-groups/title-text.md) | Styles for the module title. |
| Product Title Text | Styles for each product's title. |
| Price Text | Styles for the price. |
| Sale Price Text | Styles for the sale price. |
| [Sizing](../options-groups/sizing.md) | Module sizing. |
| [Spacing](../options-groups/spacing.md) | Margin and padding. |
| [Border](../options-groups/border.md) | Border styles. |
| [Box Shadow](../options-groups/box-shadow.md) | Box shadow styles. |
| [Filters](../options-groups/filters.md) | Hue shifts, saturation changes, and blend modes. |
| [Transform](../options-groups/transform.md) | Scaling, rotating, skewing, and translating. |
| [Animation](../options-groups/animation.md) | Entrance animation styles. |

### Advanced tab

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| [Attributes](../options-groups/attributes.md) | CSS ID, reusable classes, and custom HTML attributes for the module. |
| [CSS](../options-groups/css.md) | Custom CSS for the Woo Related Products module. |
| HTML | Semantic HTML tag for the module (see [Semantic Elements](../builder/semantic-elements.md)). |
| [Conditions](../options-groups/conditions.md) | Show the module only when set conditions are met. |
| Interactions | Trigger actions such as showing or hiding the module (see [Interactions](../builder/interactions.md)). |
| [Visibility](../options-groups/visibility.md) | Control on which devices the module appears. |
| [Transitions](../options-groups/transitions.md) | Timing of the module's hover transitions. |
| [Position](../options-groups/position.md) | Placement of the module. |
| [Scroll Effects](../options-groups/scroll-effects.md) | How the module behaves and transforms while scrolling. |
